component.name: MD Editor
component.summary: Edit Markdown without seeing the syntax

description.p: MD Editor is a lightweight WYSIWYG Markdown editor for Linux. It opens .md files already rendered, so you read and write formatted text instead of raw syntax, and everything is still saved as plain, clean Markdown on disk.
The raw source is never more than one click away: switch to split view to see Markdown and preview side by side, or to preview mode for reading.

ul.li: Tabs with session restore, and reopen of recently closed tabs
Folder sidebar for browsing a project's Markdown files
Document minimap and adjustable font size
